## Part 1. Load packages and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(ggplot2)
library(e1071)
library(tm)

artist <- read.csv("artistDf.csv")
songs <- read.csv("billboardHot100_1999-2019.csv")

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Part 2. Clean and merge the data

```{r}
artist_clean <- artist %>%
  distinct(Artist, .keep_all = TRUE)

pre_data <- songs %>%
  inner_join(artist_clean, by = c("Artists" = "Artist"))

final_data <- pre_data %>%
  filter(Group.Solo == "Solo") %>%
  mutate(Gender = toupper(trimws(Gender))) %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  distinct(Name, Artists, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\[.*?\\]", ""),
    Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\n", " "),
    Lyrics = str_squish(Lyrics)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lyrics), nchar(Lyrics) > 50) %>%
  mutate(song_id = row_number())

tokens <- final_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics)

word_totals <- tokens %>%
  count(song_id, name = "word_count")

final_data <- final_data %>%
  left_join(word_totals, by = "song_id")

nrow(final_data)

final_data %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```

## Part 3. Corpus summary by gender

```{r}
gender_counts <- final_data %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label = paste0(n, " (", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")")
  )

gender_counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gender, y = n, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Songs by Artist Gender",
    subtitle = paste("Total sample size:", nrow(final_data)),
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Number of Songs"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#d9487d", "M" = "#4472c4")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))

ggsave("figures/gender_counts.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 200)
```

## Part 4. NRC emotion words

```{r}
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

nrc_emotions <- nrc %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("anger", "anticipation", "disgust", "fear", "joy", "sadness", "surprise", "trust"))

emotion_words <- nrc_emotions %>%
  distinct(word)

emotion_by_song <- tokens %>%
  inner_join(emotion_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(song_id, name = "emotion_word_count")

emotion_props <- final_data %>%
  select(song_id, Gender, word_count) %>%
  left_join(emotion_by_song, by = "song_id") %>%
  mutate(emotion_word_count = replace_na(emotion_word_count, 0)) %>%
  mutate(prop_emotion_words = emotion_word_count / word_count)

emotion_props %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_prop = mean(prop_emotion_words),
    median_prop = median(prop_emotion_words),
    sd_prop = sd(prop_emotion_words)
  )

t.test(prop_emotion_words ~ Gender, data = emotion_props)
wilcox.test(prop_emotion_words ~ Gender, data = emotion_props)
```

## Part 5. NRC categories by gender

```{r}
emotion_summary <- tokens %>%
  inner_join(nrc_emotions, by = "word") %>%
  count(song_id, Gender, sentiment, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(word_totals, by = "song_id") %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_count) %>%
  group_by(Gender, sentiment) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop))

emotion_summary

emotion_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(sentiment, mean_prop, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

    title = "Average NRC Emotion-Word Proportion by Gender",
    x = "Emotion category",
    y = "Mean proportion of lyric tokens"

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#d9487d", "M" = "#4472c4"))

ggsave("figures/emotion_by_gender.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 200)
```

## Part 6. Bing positive and negative words

```{r}
bing <- get_sentiments("bing")

  mutate(prop = replace_na(prop, 0))

positive_scores %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%

t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = positive_scores)
```

## Part 7. Tf-idf

```{r}
gender_words <- tokens %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(Gender, word, sort = TRUE)

gender_tfidf <- gender_words %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, Gender, n) %>%
  arrange(desc(tf_idf))

female_top <- gender_tfidf %>%
  filter(Gender == "F") %>%
  slice_max(tf_idf, n = 12)

male_top <- gender_tfidf %>%
  filter(Gender == "M") %>%
  slice_max(tf_idf, n = 12)

female_top
male_top

bind_rows(female_top, male_top) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder_within(word, tf_idf, Gender), tf_idf, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Gender, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Highest TF-IDF Words by Gender",
    x = NULL,
    y = "TF-IDF score"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#d9487d", "M" = "#4472c4"))

ggsave("figures/tfidf_by_gender.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 200)
```

## Part 9. Naive Bayes

```{r}
songs_dtm <- final_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(song_id, word) %>%
  cast_dtm(song_id, word, n)

songs_dtm <- songs_dtm %>%
  weightBin()

DTM <- removeSparseTerms(songs_dtm, 0.99)
DTM_matrix <- as.matrix(DTM)
```

```{r}
n <- nrow(DTM_matrix)
training_idxs <- sample(1:n, round(n * 0.75))
testing_idxs <- c(1:n)[-training_idxs]

training_set <- DTM_matrix[training_idxs, ]
testing_set <- DTM_matrix[testing_idxs, ]

labels <- final_data %>%
  filter(song_id %in% as.integer(rownames(DTM_matrix))) %>%
  arrange(match(song_id, as.integer(rownames(DTM_matrix))))

training_labels <- labels[training_idxs, ]$Gender
testing_labels <- labels[testing_idxs, ]$Gender
```

```{r}
naive_bayes <- naiveBayes(training_set, training_labels)
prediction <- predict(naive_bayes, testing_set, type = "class")

confusion_matrix <- table(prediction, testing_labels)
confusion_matrix

evaluate <- function(cm) {
  TN <- cm[1, 1]
  FN <- cm[1, 2]
  FP <- cm[2, 1]
  TP <- cm[2, 2]

  accuracy <- (TP + TN) / sum(cm)
  precision <- TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- TP / (TP + FN)
  f1 <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  data.frame(
    accuracy = accuracy,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = f1
  )
}

evaluate(confusion_matrix)

majority_class_accuracy <- max(prop.table(table(testing_labels)))
majority_class_accuracy
```

## Part 10. Top predictive words

```{r}
scores <- sapply(naive_bayes$tables, function(x) log((x[2, 2] + 1e-06) / (x[1, 2] + 1e-06)))

sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[1:15]
sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE)[1:15]
```
